scripts.build: turbo run build:tsc build:tsdown && echo build completed successfully || (echo Please fix build errors and run pnpm run build to check for remaining build issues && exit 1)
scripts.build:tsc: tsc -b && echo build:tsc completed successfully || (echo Please fix type errors and run pnpm run build:tsc to check for remaining type issues && exit 1)
scripts.build:tsdown: tsdown && echo build:tsdown completed successfully || (echo Please fix build errors and run pnpm run build:tsdown to check for remaining build issues && exit 1)
scripts.check: turbo run --output-logs=errors-only lint:types lint:format lint:issues lint:repo build:tsc build:tsdown test:unit && echo check completed successfully
scripts.lint:format: oxfmt --check && echo lint:format completed successfully || (echo Please run pnpm run lint:format:fix to automatically fix formatting issues && exit 1)
scripts.lint:issues: oxlint --type-aware && echo lint:issues completed successfully || (echo Please fix lint issues and run pnpm run lint:issues to check for remaining issues && exit 1)
scripts.lint:repo: bun src/bin/repo-lint.cli.ts --target="src/**/*.ts" && echo lint:repo completed successfully
scripts.lint:types: tsc -p tsconfig.app.json && tsc -p tsconfig.node.json && echo lint:types completed successfully || (echo Please fix type errors and run pnpm run lint:types to check for remaining type issues && exit 1)
scripts.list: cd src && bun ./bin/barrel-maker.cli.ts --target="./lib/*.ts" --ext="" && echo list completed successfully
scripts.test:unit: vitest run --coverage && echo test:unit completed successfully || (echo Please fix test errors and run pnpm run test:unit to check for remaining test issues && exit 1)
scripts.up:deps: pnpm update --latest && echo up:deps completed successfully
